1.consolidated_definition: educ. Maestría. Título universitario, superior al bachillerato, que puede aplicarse a distintas disciplinas. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, del inglés. El máster se desarrolla a tiempo completo en dos años académicos 120 créditos, de acuerdo al Sistema Europeo de Transferencia de Créditos y se estructura en dos partes (CIHEAM, consultado 17-11-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Master's degree. A post-baccalaureate university title that can be applied to various disciplines. Adapted anglicism, infrequently used. (DRAE 2001, from English) The master's program is developed on a full-time basis over two academic years, consisting of 120 credits, in accordance with the European Credit Transfer System and is structured into two parts (CIHEAM, consulted November 17, 2008).
